about: Original short presenter lines played between songs: song -> tuning buzz -> interjection -> tuning buzz -> next song. Station idents and banter are rendered with stock Kokoro v1.0 voices (no cloning) by tool/audio/interjections.py, then radio-band processed and mastered by tool/audio/radiokit. Lines are humour and station identity only; state-derived traffic/weather guidance stays in lib/platform/proof_radio.dart.

lines.text: Sunroof FM, one oh one point three. Windows down, volume up!
You're cruising with Sunroof FM. Bright songs for bright roads.
Road trip rule number one: the driver picks the station.
Bumper sticker of the day: I brake for good songs.
Redline Rock, ninety seven point seven. Keep it loud, keep it moving!
This is Redline Rock. Guitars up, eyes on the road.
Our traffic chopper is a pigeon. He says: keep rolling.
Shout out to the air guitar in the left lane. Both hands on the wheel, please.
Iron Mile, one oh six point six. Heavy riffs for heavy feet.
You're locked on Iron Mile. Hold the line.
Mountain report: the hills are steep, the riffs are steeper.
Headbanging is fine. Keep your eyes on the road anyway.
Blue Lane, eighty eight point one. Smooth grooves for the fast lane.
Blue Lane radio. Swing a little, steer a lot.
A little horn section never hurt anybody. Unless it's in traffic.
Snap your fingers on two and four. Keep your hands on ten and two.
Ruta Caliente, noventa y cuatro punto cinco. ¡Ritmo para la carretera!
lines.caption: Ruta Caliente, 94.5. Rhythm for the road!

lines.text: Estás en Ruta Caliente. ¡Que siga la fiesta en el camino!
lines.caption: You're on Ruta Caliente. Keep the party rolling!

lines.text: Ventanas abajo, volumen arriba, y las manos en el volante.
lines.caption: Windows down, volume up, and hands on the wheel.

lines.text: ¿Un atajo? No hace falta. Con esta música, el camino vuela.
lines.caption: A shortcut? No need. With this music the road flies by.

lines.text: Back Roads, ninety point three. Fiddles, banjos and open sky.
Back Roads radio. Take the long way, but take it quick.
Snack report: the gas station jerky is holding steady.
Callers say the scenic route is lovely. They also say it's longer.
Neon Overdrive, one oh three point nine. Synths on, headlights on.
You're riding Neon Overdrive. Next exit: the future.
Fun fact: every mile you drive is a mile you don't have to walk.
Phones down, eyes up, music loud.
Cannonball Radio Network. More songs, more road, fewer red lights.
Traffic update: everybody's going somewhere. Probably somewhere fun.
Weather desk says sunglasses or wipers. Whatever the sky decides.
Long drive? Roll those shoulders at the next stop. Then floor it.
